purpose: Reconstruct eight existing AU first_clear/C/side_first journeys with known adverse outcomes, then measure actual immediate withdrawal at naturally reached protection/risk states. This is not a policy superiority comparison.
runtime: Unchanged AM terrain40_p40 + AO/AP/AQ/AR/AT/AU; AH.side_first for C; no edits to old inputs or outputs.

reconstruction.preparation: Exact AU adapt, same tag au-natural-<offset>-<first>, original seed rotation, prepare and sale-0. Verify first-return purchase eligibility; AU first-return rows have no purchase.
reconstruction.comparison_source: au/results.json paired stage first_clear route C policy side_first

selection.where: First player-ready live state satisfying each criterion within each natural C run, before the next P choice; never select by unseen future outcome.

criteria.first_protected_low_hp: At least one protected runtime reward and P.hp<=20
criteria.first_protected_low_hp_no_held_finite_he: At least one protected runtime reward, P.hp<=20, and no finite heal in current public P hand

selection.threshold_status: Diagnostic half-of-40 cutoff, not an adopted withdrawal rule.
selection.deduplication: One saved state for simultaneously first-satisfied criteria, multiple tags.
selection.absent: Report each missing criterion; do not modify HP, draws, item grants, route statistics, price, learning, or selection scope to create it.

branches.withdraw_now: Restore selected saved state and invoke unchanged Session.withdraw, then inspect actual point and AP receipt.
branches.continue_existing_journey: Use the actual suffix and terminal result of the same single reconstructed natural AU journey. Do not replay each suffix; do not treat it as an independent new sample.
branches.cutoff: Unchanged runtime action budget. An action cutoff is censored, not defeat, and not automatically settled.

checks: Save conditions before executing reconstruction or collecting AW outcomes.
Verify natural first returns and C endpoint outcome/actions/HP/time/rewards/receipt against AU, and C seed/equipment/learning/acquired blueprints.
All real actions pass unchanged Session.action prediction checks.
At the first captured state in each run, replay the same next choice after restore and compare the full save; at most eight restored one-action checks.
All withdrawals run from their captured state; compare an independent same-state withdrawal replay, check protected AP items kept and unprotected lost, and unchanged previous inventory.
Check existing journey settlement preserves prior inventory and keeps/loses exactly the acquired protected IDs by outcome.
Hash only used runtime/input source files and AW conditions/code; preserve actual action sequences and state SHA256 in a small manifest. Do not emit or change AU/AV outputs.
measurements: Protection time, current public HP, finite healing cards and deadlines, next actor action times, current target HP/posture, hand/field and public remaining deck/pool counts.
Immediate withdrawal gained points and kept/lost blueprints, compared to continuation outcome, endpoint HP, elapsed time and additional P actions.
Loss of currently protected points/items on actual defeat only; never add rewards not yet acquired at capture to current loss.
AU reproduction matches, missing criteria, restored-action/withdrawal/ownership checks.
limits: Only four reconstructed histories and two C seed values; eight correlated runs and up to 24 correlated states, not a general defeat probability.
AH side_first is the fixed historical policy, not a recommended human strategy; no averaging into optimal HP threshold and no inference of human enjoyment.
defeat is the legacy runtime identifier; world-setting interpretation is emergency escape (緊急脱出), not necessarily literal death.
No formal adoption IDs, spec changes, new content, or expansion of the trial.
